sourceToKnowledgeFrame.knowledgeFrame: Pleasure is not indulgence; it is stable freedom from pain and fear.
Pleasures and pains must be chosen by judgement over time.
Pleasure has a natural limit once pain is removed.
Friendship is central to happiness and security.
